svg.aria-label: codebase-uml draws the repo with two cycles, the findings and a phased refactor plan beside it, the measured before/after, and one dock row per phase

text.tspan: /omh-codebase-uml draw this repo, then tell me what to fix first
new seam · plugin reads types only
plugin_bundle imports routing.chat for one type
quality imports coding.fanout to score budgets
extract the shared types into coding/contracts
point plugin_bundle at the seam; drop the import
move budget scoring out of quality into coding
split wrapper.contract by session vs render
each phase: one PR · tests green before the next
aborts if a behavior lock breaks
after phase 2 · measured on the tree
next phase moves the largest module; nothing claims it until its tests pass
draw the repo and rank what to fix
One picture of the repo, ranked findings, a phased plan that aborts when a behavior lock breaks,
and a dock row per phase that says whether it ran, and whether anything checked it.
